_comment: Sample artifacts for local screenshots. Not part of `npm run seed` (artifact bodies are hashed and indexed by the repository, so they go in through POST /api/artifacts): scripts/capture-guide.mjs creates them when the local store has none. `versions` are later full-content versions; `status` and `ratify` are applied after them, in that order.

artifacts.title: Quiz agent validation failures
artifacts.summary: Breakdown of the 38 failing quiz generations from last week.
artifacts.content:
# Quiz agent validation failures

38 of 912 quiz generations failed schema validation last week (4.2%).

| Cause | Count | Fixed by |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| Trailing prose after the JSON | 21 | the new parser |
| 1-based `correct_index` on multi-select | 11 | prompt change |
| Empty distractors on short chunks | 6 | prompt change |

## Next steps

1. Add the 17 prompt-side failures to an eval set.
2. Change the prompt, then rerun the eval before shipping.
